docker.instructions: Run `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` from your Odin-Server folder to update.

notes: Security and stability update. Stronger login protection (Windows users will sign in once more after updating), safer backups and uploads, and a file dropping out mid-song no longer crashes the server. Album and playlist covers now update straight away, and the version number now opens an About page. Docker: if your JWT_SECRET is still the example value, set a new one with openssl rand -hex 32 before updating.
